# App Analytics Services
> Mobile app analytics and attribution platform focused on campaign measurement, user behavior, and growth optimization.

App Analytics Services provides analytics tooling for app marketers and product teams, including attribution, event tracking, campaign analysis, and reporting resources for mobile growth workflows.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://app-analytics-services.com/): Overview of the platform, analytics capabilities, and app growth measurement services.
- [About](https://app-analytics-services.com/about/): Company background, mission, and high-level information about the analytics service.
- [Contact](https://app-analytics-services.com/contact/): Contact options for sales, support, and general business inquiries.
- [Pricing](https://app-analytics-services.com/pricing/): Plans, feature tiers, and commercial information for the platform.
- [Features](https://app-analytics-services.com/features/): Summary of core analytics, attribution, and reporting functionality.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/): Central documentation hub for setup, usage, and platform capabilities.
- [Getting Started](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/getting-started/): Initial onboarding steps for configuring analytics and launching measurement.
- [Dashboard Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/dashboard/): Explanation of dashboards, reports, and navigation across analytics views.
- [Event Tracking](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/event-tracking/): How to define, send, and validate in-app events and conversions.
- [Attribution](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/attribution/): Attribution models, campaign mapping, and install or re-engagement measurement.
- [Reporting](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/reporting/): Report generation, filtering, exports, and interpretation of performance metrics.
- [Troubleshooting](https://app-analytics-services.com/docs/troubleshooting/): Common implementation issues, diagnostics, and recommended fixes.

## API Reference
- [API Overview](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/): Introduction to available APIs, authentication, and request conventions.
- [Authentication](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/authentication/): API keys, tokens, and secure access requirements for integrations.
- [Events API](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/events/): Endpoints for submitting app events and conversion-related activity.
- [Attribution API](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/attribution/): Programmatic access to attribution data and campaign performance information.
- [Reporting API](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/reporting/): Retrieve aggregated metrics, dimensions, and exportable analytics datasets.
- [Webhooks](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/webhooks/): Configure outbound notifications for installs, events, and attribution updates.
- [Rate Limits](https://app-analytics-services.com/api/rate-limits/): Usage limits, throttling behavior, and best practices for reliable API consumption.

## SDKs
- [SDK Overview](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/): Summary of supported client SDKs and implementation patterns.
- [iOS SDK](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/ios/): Integrate analytics and attribution tracking into iOS applications.
- [Android SDK](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/android/): Implement event collection and campaign measurement for Android apps.
- [React Native SDK](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/react-native/): Cross-platform mobile integration for React Native applications.
- [Flutter SDK](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/flutter/): Add analytics instrumentation to Flutter-based mobile apps.
- [Unity SDK](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/unity/): SDK guidance for game and app analytics in Unity projects.
- [SDK Release Notes](https://app-analytics-services.com/sdk/release-notes/): Version history, fixes, and changes across supported SDKs.

## Guides
- [Implementation Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/guides/implementation/): End-to-end setup instructions for deploying analytics in a mobile app.
- [Campaign Tracking Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/guides/campaign-tracking/): Configure campaign parameters and measure acquisition source performance.
- [Deep Linking Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/guides/deep-linking/): Set up deferred and direct deep links for acquisition and re-engagement.
- [SKAdNetwork Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/guides/skadnetwork/): Guidance for privacy-centric attribution on Apple platforms.
- [Retention Analysis Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/guides/retention-analysis/): Analyze user retention, cohorts, and lifecycle engagement trends.
- [Fraud Prevention Guide](https://app-analytics-services.com/guides/fraud-prevention/): Detect suspicious traffic patterns and improve campaign data quality.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://app-analytics-services.com/integrations/): Directory of partner platforms and supported data connections.
- [Ad Networks](https://app-analytics-services.com/integrations/ad-networks/): Connect paid media sources for attribution and campaign measurement.
- [Analytics Tools](https://app-analytics-services.com/integrations/analytics-tools/): Sync data with BI and analytics platforms for deeper analysis.
- [Data Export](https://app-analytics-services.com/integrations/data-export/): Export raw or aggregated data to external storage and reporting systems.
- [CRM Integrations](https://app-analytics-services.com/integrations/crm/): Connect customer engagement systems with app analytics workflows.
- [Partner Setup](https://app-analytics-services.com/integrations/partner-setup/): Steps for enabling and validating third-party integrations.
